speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC). The ultrasound showing thickening and dilatation of the bile ducts, combined with your history of ulcerative colitis and elevated Alkaline Phosphatase, is highly specific for this condition. While your fatigue and pruritus are consistent with cholestasis, the absence of jaundice in this early stage does not rule it out. Given the strong association between PSC and inflammatory bowel disease, your diagnosis is likely confirmed.
